title: Mixispotions
description: This mod adds new potions with new effects, that i make for fun!
body:
This mod adds potions, effects, ect.(i make them for fun).

The current version features:
- Potion of Flight (Can be brewed in a Brewing Stand by putting slowfalling potions at the bottom and a Brezerod at the top)
  - After drinking, the player is able to use creative flight


  
      ![Recipe for Potion of Flight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03b7ef3c1c3f5ddcfbccaf1dcce2122bbd7dc03f.png)
- Lightning in a Bottle (Can be optained by standing in a 5 block radius of a lightningbolt with a slowness potion in hand)
  - After drinking, the player can no longer move.

You can make your own suggestion and bugs known in my Issues tab
